description: Text an automation's messages to your own verified phone or a verified recipient now, skipping waits and conditions, without activating it (drafts work). Pass sample event properties; `steps` sends only those step ids. No run starts and stats do not change. Texts from a live number are real and billed.

from.description: Optional. Send this test from another of your numbers in the same mode (the automation is not changed), e.g. a verified toll-free while its own number is in review.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries are already safe: the same call with the same inputs within 10 minutes is done once and answers with the first result. Pass your own key to dedupe across a longer gap, or a new one to repeat an identical call on purpose.

properties.description: Sample event properties for merge fields

steps.description: Only these send_sms step ids. Default: all of them

to.description: E.164: your own verified phone or a verified recipient

name: test_automation
title: Test automation
